hazards.evidence: Furniture placement (recliner, sofa, TV stand, side tables) creates a narrow central path; walker may have difficulty navigating between items.
The dark blue recliner and light armchair have soft, deep seats and low height, which may make standing up difficult without proper armrest support for someone recovering from hip/knee surgery.
Bright sunlight through windows creates glare on the hardwood floor, which may reduce visibility of floor texture or small obstacles.
The white interior door has a visible threshold/sill that may catch a walker wheel or foot, posing a tripping hazard.
The doorway leading to the adjacent room appears narrow; a walker may not fit through easily without scraping or getting stuck.
